biology.human-impact-recall-multi.0003.a: kills trees/leaves damaged; lakes acidified, fish die

biology.human-nutrition-data-graph.0003.a: energy requirement increases with age up to ~18, then levels off / slightly decreases to 30; quote data
biology.human-nutrition-data-graph.0003.b: growth; more body mass/cells; more respiration; more active

biology.human-nutrition-data-pct.0002.b: amylase digests starch to maltose; starch decreases; rate slows as substrate used up; levels off when all starch digested (0.7 remains)

biology.human-nutrition-data-plot.0004.a: axes labelled, scale, points, smooth curve
biology.human-nutrition-data-plot.0004.b: increases with age up to 18 years; peak 10200 kJ at 18; then slight decrease to 9775 kJ at 30

biology.human-nutrition-data-read.0002.c: amylase breaks down starch into maltose; rate slows as less substrate

biology.human-nutrition-describe.0001.all: circular and longitudinal muscles in wall contract and relax alternately; circular muscle contracts behind food bolus, squeezing it forward; wave of contraction

biology.human-nutrition-describe-multi.0.b: circular/longitudinal muscles antagonistic; contract behind bolus; wave pushes food along

biology.human-nutrition-explain.0007.all: adds bulk to food/faeces; muscles of gut can push it along by peristalsis, preventing constipation

biology.human-nutrition-explain-multi.00.b: neutralises stomach acid giving alkaline/optimum pH for enzymes in small intestine; emulsifies fats increasing surface area for lipase

biology.human-nutrition-ext.0011.all: bile made in liver, stored in gall bladder, released into duodenum via bile duct; alkaline, neutralises stomach acid -> optimum pH for lipase; emulsifies fat into small droplets -> larger surface area; faster lipase digestion to fatty acids and glycerol; absorbed in ileum (lacteals)

biology.human-nutrition-mcq.0003.all: it emulsifies lipids and neutralises stomach acid

biology.human-nutrition-mcq-rev.0009.all: Helps food move through the gut and prevents constipation

biology.human-nutrition-prac-method.0002.all: set up tubes with same volume milk + indicator, with and without bile salts (same volume, water instead); equilibrate in water bath at same temp; add same volume lipase; start timer; time how long for colour change; repeat

biology.human-nutrition-prac-plan.0002.all: IV bile salts present/absent (or concentration); same volume milk, indicator, lipase concentration, temp in water bath, pH start; measure time for indicator colour change (fatty acids lower pH); repeat 3 times and calculate mean; control with no lipase/boiled lipase

biology.human-nutrition-prac-reliab.0002.a: identify anomalous results; calculate mean so results more reliable
biology.human-nutrition-prac-reliab.0002.b: tube with boiled (denatured) lipase or water instead of lipase; shows that colour change is due to lipase activity

biology.human-nutrition-prac-risk.0001.a: burning food/hot water could burn; use tongs/heatproof mat, stand away, wear goggles; or allergy to nuts - avoid handling
biology.human-nutrition-prac-risk.0001.b: insulate/shield tube to reduce heat loss; stir water; make sure food burns completely; use thermometer of higher resolution

biology.human-nutrition-prac-step.0004.all: keeps temperature constant (control variable) so only bile salts affect rate; 35 °C near optimum for lipase so reaction fast enough

biology.human-nutrition-prac-vars.0001.b: temperature rise of the water (energy per gram)
biology.human-nutrition-prac-vars.0001.c: volume of water; mass of food; distance of food from tube; starting temperature
